summary.text: If you have severe disability and are insured under ElderShield, apply to claim under ElderShield. You cannot join CareShield Life.

details.heading: Why not CareShield Life
details.body: You will not be eligible to join CareShield Life after developing severe disability.

steps.name: Apply under ElderShield
steps.text: Apply to claim under ElderShield so you can receive your monthly claim payouts in a timely manner.

example_phrasings: Should I claim ElderShield or join CareShield Life?
Which scheme should I use if I can claim ElderShield?
Can I join CareShield Life after becoming severely disabled?

sources.page_title: I am an existing ElderShield insured. If I am eligible for ElderShield claims, should I claim from ElderShield or join CareShield Life?

quotes.text: If you are unable to perform three or more Activities of Daily Living (i.e. have developed severe disability), and is an ElderShield insured, you should apply to claim under ElderShield so that you can receive your monthly claim payouts in a timely manner.
you should apply to claim under ElderShield so that you can receive your monthly claim payouts in a timely manner.
You will not be eligible for CareShield Life if you have developed severe disability.
